<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User wants modern island with integrated sink. Contractor quote is $18,400.
* 🟡 (07:30) Agent searched suppliers for 36-inch undermount stainless sinks; highlighted $515 model for quiet disposal system; scheduled virtual demo.
* 🟢 (08:10) User enjoys cooking Italian dishes; pet dog Bella will be in kitchen during renovations.
* 🔴 (11:05) User asked about matte black faucet match with island design; approved matte black faucet and requested matching soap dispenser with pull-out spray head.
* 🟡 (18:05) Agent contacted GreenPipe Co. to confirm plumbing availability next week.
* 🔴 (20:20) User set deadline to finalize all fixture selections by May 10, 2026.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User prefers brushed nickel finish for cabinet hardware. Revised contractor quote is $21,250.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent queried LumiBright Co. for LED under-cabinet strip; highlighted $275 kit with dimmable RGB options.
* 🟢 (08:30) User enjoys hosting weekend brunches; cat Whiskers naps on kitchen floor.
* 🔴 (11:30) User asked if waterfall edge countertop complements island; approved 2-cm quartz waterfall slab ($4,200, StoneCraft Ltd.) and requested matching herringbone subway tile backsplash ($1,150, TileMosaic Inc.). Countertop delivery: May 15, 9 AM-12 PM.
* 🔴 (17:00) User set new internal deadline to finalize backsplash selection by May 12, 2026.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User expressed interest in pull-out pantry drawer; asked about pot-filler faucet beside stainless sink.
* 🟢 (08:20) Partner prefers matte white walls; teenage daughter needs weekend snack station; user plans garden-to-table dinner on May 20 with garnish herb garden.
* 🟡 (08:55) Agent retrieved ColorWave paint swatches, highlighting "Arctic Fog" ($45/gal, low VOC); scheduled color consultation.
* 🟡 (11:20) Agent received quote of $420 for pull-out pot-filler model PF-250 from FaucetWorks Ltd.
* 🟡 (12:35) Agent sourced compact under-counter fridge (ChillBox CB-300, $1,120) and self-watering herb kit ($85, GreenThumb).
* 🔴 (15:15) User set firm deadline to finalize all appliance selections by May 18, 2026.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User confirmed "Calacatta Gold" quartz countertop for island ($4,750, StoneWorks Quarry, installer site visit May 15 at 9 AM).
* 🟢 (11:50) Cat Luna needs temporary safe zone with portable air purifier ($85).
* 🔴 (13:05) User set milestone to approve lighting by May 16; rule: always send photos before opening walls.
* 🔴 (14:10) User wants small wine fridge on right side of pantry (VinoVault VC-210, $920).
* 🟡 (13:45) Agent compiled LED under-cabinet lighting (BrightBeam 3000K strip, $68/fixture) and brushed nickel handles ($12 each); sent 3-D render.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed matte white cabinets (Oakridge Cabinets, 'LunaSeries', $1,850 each, delivery June 5).
* 🔴 (08:55) User asked about glass subway tile backsplash in 'Arctic Pearl' ($42/pack, TileWorld).
* 🟢 (10:05) User hosting brunch on June 12; requested built-in coffee station with grinder and 2-gal water reservoir in pantry.
* 🔴 (11:50) User requested plumbing permit submitted by May 22 (obtained PR-2026-517). Electrical inspection booked with CityPower for May 20 at 2 PM.
* 🟢 (13:00) User out of town May 24-26; agent adjusted noisy demolition to May 27 at 8 AM.
* 🟡 (14:10) Agent ordered matte black faucet handles ('Eclipse', FlowDesign, $135).
* ✅ (14:45) Agent uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and new faucet.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected "RiverEdge" light gray 2-cm quartz countertop from StoneCraft ($3,200/slab, 3 slabs ordered, delivery June 8).
* 🔴 (08:50) User asked about brushed nickel pendant lights ("Nimbus", $89 each, LuminaLighting).
* 🟢 (09:55) User prefers island wine cooler with 12-bottle capacity (ChillBox C12, 150W). User hosting dinner party June 20, wants dimmable lighting (programmed with Zig-Bee dimmer).
* 🔴 (11:40) User requested smart thermostat integration ("EcoTemp Pro", serial ET-2026-09, installation June 15).
* 🟡 (11:05) Booked plumbing rough-in inspection with WaterWorks Services for May 28 at 10 AM.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent uploaded revised floor plan showing countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent sent summary email with milestones: countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15.
* 🔴 (18:00) User stated appliance allowance is $6,300.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Awaiting user review/feedback on the revised floor plan, appliance allowance details, and upcoming milestone schedule for the kitchen remodel.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the floor plan with your RiverEdge quartz countertops and island wine cooler. Let me know if you'd like to adjust any selections or review the upcoming milestone schedule."
</suggested-response>
